youtube.title: Why Camels Have Humps 🐪 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A camel's hump is not a water tank. It is a store of fat, which can weigh dozens of kilograms in a well-fed camel. Keeping the fat in one lump instead of spreading it across the body helps the camel shed heat in the desert. The animal survives long stretches without water through other adaptations, like very efficient kidneys and the ability to drink huge amounts at once.
